# 銅頭級採礦穿梭艦
[color=#a4885c]船隻尺寸：[/color] 小型
[color=#a4885c]建議船員人數：[/color] 2 人以上
[color=#a4885c]發電類型：[/color] 鈾
[color=#a4885c]探勘任務：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別（IFF）控制台：[/color] 無
「Copperhead 是一艘價格實惠、用途廣泛的小型穿梭機，具備充足的改裝空間，專為採礦與打撈任務所優化。 無論是在編隊中運作，還是自主運作，其設計都是在「速度」（對中長途航行至關重要）與「機動性」（對穿越小行星帶至關重要）之間取得的一種折衷。 Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries."
# 運作 LVHI Copperhead 穿梭機的要訣 - 發電機組的 [bold]目標功率[/bold]（kW）最佳值為 [color=#a4885c]17 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - There are two buttons in the cockpit: the one with a yellow and black frame controls the window shutters. 帶有灰色邊框的按鈕用於切換推進器與陀螺儀。
- For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
